experience with rehab therapy either through educational affiliations or prior work experience.

Appropriately evaluates patients in: range of motion; edema; muscle strength and endurance; sensation, reflexes, neurovascular status; soft tissue, bony palpation, passive joint mobilization; body mechanics, work efficiency, aerobic cap; activities of daily living; coordination; pain.

Develops and implements appropriate treatments programs: orients patient and family to his/her individual treatment program; develops realistic ADL, work and leisure goals with patient; provides goal directed purposeful activities; progresses patient appropriately on all activities; reevaluates, sets new goals, and adjusts treatment programs accordingly; prepares patient for discharge; provides home programs.
Elicits and records information about patients medical history.
Produces timely documentation within departmental guidelines.
Performs worksite visits when necessary to address job modifications.
Analyzes reports and findings of tests and of examination, and diagnoses condition.
